name: test-build
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 3 * * 2"

concurrency:
  group: "${{ github.ref }}"
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-debian:
    strategy:
      # Keep other matrix jobs running, even if one fails.
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        host_release:
          - unstable
          - forky
          - trixie

    # We want a working shell, qemu, python and docker. Specific version should not matter (much).
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - run: ./test/gha-build-deb.sh
        name: "Build .deb for ${{matrix.host_release}}"
        env:
          HOST_RELEASE: ${{matrix.host_release}}

      - name: Archive built .deb
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7
        with:
          name: deb-${{matrix.host_release}}
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            *.deb

  build-iso:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        extra_classes:
          - ""
          - "GRML_GHACI_CLOUD"
        arch:
          - amd64
          - arm64

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.arch == 'arm64' && 'ubuntu-24.04-arm' || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1  # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - run: ./test/gha-build-iso.sh initial
        name: "Build ISO on ${{matrix.arch}}${{matrix.extra_classes && format(' with {0}', matrix.extra_classes) || ''}}"
        env:
          EXTRA_CLASSES: ${{matrix.extra_classes}}
          ARCH: ${{matrix.arch}}
          GITHUB_PR_NUMBER: ${{github.event.pull_request.number}}

      - name: Archive built ISO
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7
        with:
          name: grml-live-build-result-initial-${{github.event.pull_request.number && format('pr{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || 'unknown'}}-${{matrix.arch}}${{matrix.extra_classes && format('-{0}', matrix.extra_classes) || ''}}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 15
          path: |
            results-initial/*

      - run: ./test/gha-build-iso.sh build-only-twice
        name: "Repack ISO twice ${{matrix.arch}}${{matrix.extra_classes && format(' with {0}', matrix.extra_classes) || ''}}"
        env:
          EXTRA_CLASSES: ${{matrix.extra_classes}}
          ARCH: ${{matrix.arch}}
          GITHUB_PR_NUMBER: ${{github.event.pull_request.number}}

      - name: Archive repacked ISO
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9  # v7
        with:
          name: grml-live-build-result-repack-${{github.event.pull_request.number && format('pr{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) || 'unknown'}}-${{matrix.arch}}${{matrix.extra_classes && format('-{0}', matrix.extra_classes) || ''}}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 15
          path: |
            results-build-only-second/*
